{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation changes in doc/assumeutxo.md and release notes directly follow the code change rather than being standalone documentation work.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Doc updates are secondary to the assumeutxo architectural change."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/base.cpp (+1/-1) and baseindex_tests.cpp (+17/-0) purely as adjustments to the snapshot startup sequence.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to base index are incidental test adjustments and follow from validation init sequencing."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mentions avoiding mempool races by loading snapshots prior to mempool initialization, but does not alter mempool data structures or policy rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change mempool policy, validation, or transaction acceptance logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/net.h only to remove CConnman::RemoveLocalServices, an internal method previously used to demote advertised services mid-run.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental removal of an unused connman helper does not constitute a substantive change to P2P protocol or networking behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Deprecates and stubs out the `loadtxoutset` RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+9/-79).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retires the `loadtxoutset` RPC method in favor of a startup option. While breaking changes to RPC interfaces require compatibility review, this method is part of the still-experimental assumeutxo workflow."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test and fuzz harness edits in src/test/ and test/functional/ update existing test coverage to use `-loadtxoutset`.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications pin assumeutxo behavior rather than improving shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches contrib/completions/bash/bitcoind.bash (+1/-1) only to add bash completion for the new argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Bash completion update is a trivial follow-up to the new command-line option."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/init.cpp (+51/-4) to parse `-loadtxoutset` and trigger snapshot import during startup.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup argument addition in init.cpp exists solely to serve assumeutxo chainstate loading rather than general utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns the assumeutxo snapshot activation lifecycle across src/validation.cpp, src/node/utxo_snapshot.cpp, and chainstate management.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Shifting UTXO snapshot loading to node startup eliminates significant runtime coordination hazards. It removes mid-run validation cache resizing, dynamic network service demotion, and race conditions against active mempools and advancing chain tips."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies test/functional/wallet_assumeutxo.py (+23/-16) to adjust functional tests to the new startup flag.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test update merely adapts wallet assumeutxo test fixtures to the new initialization mechanism."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
